**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Handle the bundled Windows wheel on non-Windows hosts**

On Linux and macOS, the committed `cp313-win_amd64` RDKit package raises `AttributeError` from `os.add_dll_directory` during package initialization, rather than `ImportError`. Consequently both `freesolv_validator.py` and `tests_regression.py` terminate immediately instead of taking the documented `RDKIT_AVAILABLE=False`/BLOCKED path; detect the incompatible platform before importing the bundled package or handle this initialization failure explicitly.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Include RDKit bytes in the integrity manifest**

The validator imports all chemistry operations from `.deps/rdkit`, but none of that package's Python or binary files—and no exact RDKit version—are covered here. A later commit can replace the bundled RDKit implementation and alter charge, scaffold, and feature calculations while both working-tree and `--git-revision HEAD` verification still report 7/7 PASS, so the claimed executable-artifact identity is incomplete; add a dependency lock or digest covering the RDKit distribution.
